title: GO:1905523: PCA of Conjoint triad
caption: PCA projection of all 268 proteins in the GO:1905523 pool, described by Conjoint triad (343 dimensions). Silhouette of the two classes in the 2-D map: 0.26. The first two components explain 12.8% and 9.4% of variance. Positives are drawn on top of negatives.
